name: kshama-delhi-bus-crowding-film
description: 3-minute demo film for the Delhi Bus Crowding Planner (Team Kshama), built with Remotion

scripts.studio: npm run scan && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.draft: npm run scan && remotion render src/index.ts Main out/draft.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render: npm run scan && remotion render src/index.ts Main out/kshama-delhi-bus-crowding.mp4 --codec=h264 --audio-codec=aac --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p
